name: Wheat Germ Oil
description: Wheat germ oil is an elite, unrefined botanical lipid whole food matrix. Extracted from the nutrient-dense inner core of the wheat kernel, it commands the highest concentration of natural Vitamin E (*alpha-tocopherol*) in the entire plant kingdom, alongside a specialized distribution of long-chain fatty alcohols like *policosanol*, serving as an unparalleled dietary asset for deep cellular membrane protection, vascular defense, and mitochondrial optimization.
macroIntro: The macronutrient framework of unrefined wheat germ oil delivers an ultra-dense, pure lipid profile heavily concentrated with essential polyunsaturated fatty acids engineered for cellular membrane structural preservation and endocrine raw material production.
microIntro: Wheat germ oil houses a spectacular, hyper-concentrated pool of lipophilic antioxidants and bioactive plant sterols designed to neutralize systemic lipid peroxidation loops and preserve vascular tone.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: An exceptionally dense biological energy source composed entirely of pure structural lipids, providing high-caliber fat fuel for cellular respiration.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: Completely free of proteins or amino acid fractions, isolating its therapeutic utility entirely within the body's lipid-soluble pathways.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: A premier lipid matrix dominated by essential polyunsaturated linoleic acid (Omega-6) and monounsaturated oleic acid to keep cell membranes fluid.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Contains absolute zero carbohydrates, starches, or sugars, ensuring zero impact on postprandial glucose fluctuations or insulin shifts.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol)
microNutrients.description: An astronomical mega-dose of natural d-alpha-tocopherol per 100g, yielding the most potent fat-soluble free-radical scavenger available to halt oxidation.

microNutrients.name: Octacosanol & Policosanols
microNutrients.description: Unique, very long-chain primary aliphatic alcohols that optimize cellular oxygen utilization and assist in physical stamina pathways.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin K
microNutrients.description: A valuable distribution of fat-soluble vitamin K that supports the liver's synthesis of coagulation factors and structural tissue maintenance.

microNutrients.name: Omega-6 (Linoleic Acid)
microNutrients.description: An abundant pool of essential polyunsaturated fatty acids, crucial for cellular barrier architecture and eicosanoid balancing.

microNutrients.name: Omega-9 (Oleic Acid)
microNutrients.description: A robust concentration of heart-healthy monounsaturated fatty acids that safeguard arterial lining flexibility and systemic lipid transport.

microNutrients.name: Plant Phytosterols
microNutrients.description: Bioactive plant sterols that structurally mimic cholesterol in the gut, competing for absorption to modulate circulating lipid levels.

healthBenefits: Monumental Lipid Membrane Shielding: Unparalleled natural reserves of Vitamin E halt the chain reaction of lipid peroxidation, defending delicate cellular double-bonds, neurological myelin sheaths, and erythrocytes from oxidative breakdown.

Advanced Endothelial & Vascular Defense: The direct coordination between mega-dose Alpha-Tocopherol and natural *phytosterols* blocks the oxidation of circulating LDL particles, preserving arterial elasticity and preventing plaque accumulation loops.

Cellular Oxygen Efficiency Optimization: Highly active baseline stores of *octacosanol* improve the body's internal oxygen utilization efficiency during intense exertion, helping to upgrade muscular endurance and glycogen storage profiles.

Dermal Architecture & Matrix Repair: Delivering an exceptional concentration of lipophilic antioxidants straight to skin tissues, it drives rapid cellular remodeling, stabilizes elastin frameworks, and accelerates dermal barrier recovery.
precautionsIntro: While unrefined wheat germ oil operates as a premier therapeutic asset, its delicate lipid bonds and specific botanical origins demand exact processing and tracking metrics.
precautions: Extreme Sensitivity to Thermal Oxidation: Due to the high density of delicate polyunsaturated fatty acids, wheat germ oil has a critically low smoke point and is completely ruined by high-temperature frying or baking, which rapidly mutates its clean lipids into toxic peroxides. Use exclusively cold as a finishing oil.

Rapid Atmospheric Degradation (Rancidity): Exposure to air, light, or ambient heat accelerates internal oxidative degradation, quickly turning the oil rancid and depleting its Vitamin E pool. Storing it in tightly sealed, dark amber glass bottles entirely within a refrigerated environment is mandatory.

Gluten-Protein Cross-Contamination Vectors: While pure, highly refined oils consist strictly of isolated lipids, unrefined cold-pressed wheat germ oil can carry microscopic residual trace fractions of gluten proteins. Individuals navigating a verified clinical history of Celiac disease or extreme wheat hypersensitivity must enforce strict caution.

Concentrated Omega-6 Sizing Balance: Because wheat germ oil possesses a heavily skewed Omega-6 to Omega-3 ratio, relying on massive unmonitored daily doses without balancing overall dietary intake with anti-inflammatory marine Omega-3 fatty acids can alter systemic eicosanoid harmony.
